main_text.head: CAP. XIIII.
main_text.p: Quia vita æterna est supra Condignum operis cu-juscunque. Ex Scriptu-ris, sect. 2. ex Patribus, sect.3. Objest. sol. sect.4.Q
main_text.head: CAP. XV.
main_text.p: Quia opus bonum nihil quicquam Deum juvat. Scriptura, sect. 2. Patres, sect. 3.
main_text.head: CAP. XVI.
main_text.p: Quia talis venditatio apud homines esset odiosa & execrabilis. Ex Scriptu-ris, sect. 2. ex Patribus, sect. 3. ex Ethicis, sect. 4. Ex Philosophis, sect.5. & ex Pontificiis, sect. 6.AQ Contra Pontificiorum ul-timum refugium, quasi Christus meruerit nobis virtutem merendi.
main_text.head: CAP. XVIII.
main_text.p: Quia prætextus iste est derogatorius propriis Christi meritis: probatur per Theses quatuor, sect.3,4,5,6. Quia Pro-testantium doctrina magis amplificat Christi merita, sect.7.8,9. Quia Patres Pontificiis ad-versantur, sect.10, & 11. Vindicatio senten-tiæ Augustini, sect.12. Quia antiquæ Romanæ Ecclesiæ fidei repugnat, sect.13. Et hodiernæ Ec-clesiæ praxi, sect.14.
main_text.head: CAP. XVIII.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "Objest" in the italic reference line is uncertain (printed with a long-s ligature). The marginal letters on the right are isolated fragments and cannot be read further. The left part of the page is cut off, so the first words of several lines are fragments and are printed as far as they are visible. The running head is only the fragment "dus.". The second chapter heading also reads "CAP. XVIII." and is followed by "Argumentum nostrum un-decimum", which suggests a printing error for XIX; the numeral is copied as printed. The final paragraph runs on past the bottom of this part. The long s is transcribed as s throughout.
